<!--
  The head of a section: an optional badge, the heading (h1 or h2) with an optional link opposite it, and an
  optional lead. No wrapper: its parts are children of the section stack.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { SectionHeading, HeadLink } from "./section-frame.types";

export type SectionHeaderProps = {
  titleId: string;
  title?: string;
  heading?: SectionHeading;
  action?: HeadLink;
  lead?: string;
  center?: boolean;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Badge from "../primitives/badge/badge.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import Link from "../primitives/link/link.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import Title from "../primitives/title/title.vue";
import { defaults } from "../presets/defaults";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const { titleId, title = "", heading, action, lead, center = false } = defineProps<SectionHeaderProps>();
const level = computed(() => heading?.level ?? 2);
const scale = computed(() => heading?.scale ?? "default");
const linkHref = computed(() => action?.href ?? "#/");
</script>

<template>
  <Badge
    v-if="heading?.badge"
    variant="outline"
    size="lg"
    :class="(center ? 'mx-auto w-fit' : 'w-fit')"
    data-testid="section-badge"
  >
    {{ heading?.badge }}
  </Badge>
  <Group
    v-if="(((title as string) !== '') && action?.label)"
    gap="4"
    align="center"
    justify="between"
    class="w-full flex-wrap"
  >
    <Title
      :as="level"
      :size="((level === 1) ? '5xl' : 'xl')"
      weight="semibold"
      :class="
        (scale as string) === 'display' ? 'text-6xl tracking-tight md:text-8xl'
        : level === 1 ? 'leading-tight'
        : 'leading-7'
      "
      :id="titleId"
    >
      {{ title }}
    </Title>
    <Link
      :href="linkHref"
      variant="default"
      :class="cn(defaults.text.tiny, 'shrink-0 font-medium leading-5')"
      data-testid="section-action"
    >
      {{ action?.label }}
    </Link>
  </Group>
  <Title v-if="(((title as string) !== '') && !action?.label)"
    :as="level"
    :size="((level === 1) ? '5xl' : 'xl')"
    weight="semibold"
    :class="
      (scale as string) === 'display' ? 'text-6xl tracking-tight md:text-8xl'
      : level === 1 ? 'leading-tight'
      : 'leading-7'
    "
    :id="titleId"
  >
    {{ title }}
  </Title>
  <Group
    v-if="(((title as string) === '') && action?.label)"
    gap="4"
    align="center"
    justify="end"
    class="w-full"
  >
    <Link
      :href="linkHref"
      variant="default"
      :class="cn(defaults.text.tiny, 'shrink-0 font-medium leading-5')"
      data-testid="section-action"
    >
      {{ action?.label }}
    </Link>
  </Group>
  <Text v-if="lead" size="base" :class="cn('max-w-2xl text-muted-foreground', (center ? 'mx-auto' : ''))">
    {{ lead }}
  </Text>
</template>
